questions.question: Is Microsoft Word a sophisticated word processing application?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, Microsoft Word is a sophisticated word processing application.
questions.evidence_quote: Microsoft Word is a sophisticated word processing application.

questions.question: What is the growth rate of the laptop industry?
questions.expected_answer: Slow: laptop sales are expected to grow around 1% annually.
questions.evidence_quote: The laptop industry is growing at a rather slow rate with sales expected to grow around 1% annually.

questions.question: In Google Docs, as you are writing the report, what can Docs help with for the references?
questions.expected_answer: You can cite the source and Docs does the formatting of the reference.
questions.evidence_quote: As you are writing the report, you can cite the source, and have Docs do the formatting of the reference.

questions.question: Which Word tab contains font formatting, alignment, headings and the Find commands?
questions.expected_answer: The Home tab.
questions.evidence_quote: The Home tab is where you will spend most of your time, as it contains the formatting of fonts, alignment, headings, numbering, and lists, as well as the Find commands.

questions.question: What text size and page borders are normally expected in a business report?
questions.expected_answer: A 12-point body font and one-inch margins on all sides.
questions.evidence_quote: a 12-point font for body text (Calibri, Times New Roman, and Cambria are some popular fonts), and one-inch margins on all sides (top, bottom, left, right) are typically standard.

questions.question: How does the paper size used in Europe differ from the one used in the United States?
questions.expected_answer: The US uses letter size (8.5 x 11 inches); Europe and East Asia use A4 (8.25 x 11.75 inches).
questions.evidence_quote: the United States uses standard letter size (8.5 inches wide by 11 inches long), whereas Europe and East Asia typically use A4 size (8.25 inches wide by 11.75 inches long).

questions.question: In which case should the WorldCorp market trends report be fully justified?
questions.expected_answer: When it is submitted for publication in an industry journal.
questions.evidence_quote: if you submit your WorldCorp market trends report for publication in an industry journal, it should be fully justified.

questions.question: Can I rely on spell-check to catch a correctly spelled word used in the wrong place?
questions.expected_answer: No. Spell-check does not always catch misused words, so you still need to proofread.
questions.evidence_quote: It should be noted that spell-check will not always check when a word is misused.

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, how do you add a comment to a piece of text?
questions.expected_answer: Select the text, then choose New Comment on the Review tab.
questions.evidence_quote: To add a comment, select the segment of text in question, and then select New Comment from the Review tab

questions.question: How can I switch between seeing everyone's edits and a clean copy of the document?
questions.expected_answer: Toggle between No Markup and All Markup in the Tracking command group.
questions.evidence_quote: You can toggle between No Markup and All Markup to see tracked and clean versions of a document

questions.question: What does Paste without formatting do?
questions.expected_answer: It pastes only the text, without the source formatting such as font, font size or color.
questions.evidence_quote: Paste without formatting is a useful tool for copying and pasting text only, without any of the source formatting (such as font, font size, or color).

questions.question: In Google Docs, where do you find the Page Setup commands?
questions.expected_answer: In the File menu, near the bottom.
questions.evidence_quote: In Docs, it is all done from the File menu; Page Setup is near the bottom of the File menu.

questions.question: To set text in two columns, do I have to select the whole section first?
questions.expected_answer: No. Column formatting applies to the section or paragraph the cursor is in; select paragraphs only if you want several of them.
questions.evidence_quote: You do not have to do anything like selecting the whole section or document because the column formatting will apply to the section or paragraph you are in.

questions.question: Does every document theme use the same default body font?
questions.expected_answer: No. Different themes have different Normal font settings.
questions.evidence_quote: Different themes have different Normal font settings.

questions.question: Does Google Docs save my changes on its own, and is there any condition?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, it autosaves every change, as long as you are connected to the internet.
questions.evidence_quote: Docs has a feature that, as long as you are connected to the internet, autosaves every change you make to the file.

questions.question: In Google Docs, how do you turn on the mode that records each collaborator's edits?
questions.expected_answer: Open the Editing drop-down menu at the top right of the window and choose Suggesting.
questions.evidence_quote: To turn on Suggesting mode, go to the top right of the Docs window and look for the drop-down menu that says Editing.

questions.question: If I make a copy of an older version of a Doc, do its comments and history come with it?
questions.expected_answer: No. The copy is a new Doc without the version history, and comments and suggestions are not copied.
questions.evidence_quote: When a copy is made of any version of a document, it is saved as a new Doc, without the version history attached to it. The comments and suggestions are also not copied.

questions.question: With desktop Word, how many earlier versions of a file can I open, and what is required?
questions.expected_answer: The last 25 versions, but only if the file is stored on OneDrive (and you are signed in to your Microsoft account).
questions.evidence_quote: You will be able to access the last 25 versions of your file on OneDrive (that is, if your file is stored on OneDrive)

questions.question: Why can wider line spacing help when several people are reviewing a draft?
questions.expected_answer: Double-spacing gives better visibility of the edits and makes revisions in progress easier to see.
questions.evidence_quote: This allows for better visibility for the changes or edits, and makes it easier to see the revisions in progress.

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, where do you go to adjust the margins of a page?
questions.expected_answer: The Layout tab, then the Margins icon.
questions.evidence_quote: To adjust the margins of a page, go to the Layout tab.

questions.question: Can a user export only the images embedded in a document?
